rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for graceful, tasteful, or refined appearance and manner.

example.english: The decor of this hotel is elegant and tasteful.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店嘅裝修優雅大方。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 zong1 sau1 jau1 ngaa5 daai6 fong1

rows.note: Use this for a person or their manner and appearance when the emphasis is cultured, well-mannered refinement rather than visual grace.

example.english: He looks elegant in a suit.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 sai1 zong1 hou2 si1 man4

rows.note: Use this for an elegant solution when the emphasis is cleverness, ingenuity, and intuitive precision.

example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 gaai2 faat3 zan1 hai6 haau2 miu6

rows.note: Use this for an elegant solution when the emphasis is minimalism and lack of unnecessary complexity.

example.english: This design is elegant and very easy to use.
example.traditional: 呢個設計夠簡潔，用落好方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 gau3 gaan2 git3 jung6 lok6 hou2 fong1 bin6
